semanticKindReason: A standalone ordinary assessment of one curricular learning goal through two numerical applications. It introduces no curricular competency, combines no assessment cluster and requires no capstone synthesis.
coverageReason: The assessment directly requires exactly its covered ordinary learning goal. Choosing a positive direction, calculating four signed individual momenta from simultaneous data and adding them implements that goal. Cancellation is part of signed addition. No collision law, conservation argument, additional covered goal or invented prerequisite is required.
offerReason: All six supplied HH/TH offer rows contain the complete 22-object prerequisite closure within their unpruned source-stage learning basis and every actual GK/LK, G8/G9 lower learning basis. Actual task demands are confined to the existing momentum goal and elementary signed arithmetic. Existing Math and orientation prerequisites remain prerequisites, rather than new assessed targets. View, lower-authority and source-policy hashes agree with the packet inventory. Applicability boundaries restrict this assessment to HH/TH; the ordinary goal's broader applicability and framework metadata do not create HE exposure. Curricular source assignments make no official examination-task claim.
rubricPolicyReason: The four published 3-point criteria total 12; passing at 10 is 83.33%, within the required limits. The solution and criteria explicitly implement both owner rules, preserve valid follow-through and distinguish supported local slips from substantive or repeated errors. Missing major numerical performances cannot be replaced by qualitative statements or generic formulas. Passing uses points alone, without an additional veto or explanatory requirement. Complete bilingual criterion lengths are MI 1487, TI 1500, MII 1614 and TII 1783 UTF-16 units, each below 2000.

minimalCompletenessFindings: Meaningful minimum completeness is enforced. Missing either complete total scores 9 at most, as Scef6c3a723 and S664ec70c63 demonstrate. Individual-only S339c29fd58 scores 6; formula-only S7c205c2a84 scores 0; qualitative S2c782e64d9 scores 0.5; bare-total and magnitude-only works cannot pass. Exact numerical expressions, directed magnitudes and identifiable individual terms inside totals receive full credit. The intentional exception for one substantive wrong cart value is implemented without widening it to repeated errors or pair swaps. Cutoff arithmetic is respected: S63530cd55e and Sffc6e848f1 pass at 10; S8948865e9a and Se9fd42fbb8 fail at 9.5.
bilingualVerdict: The DE/EN assessment tasks, solutions, scoring criteria and all 48 submission pairs are substantively equivalent and receive identical grades.
limitations: Offer acceptance concerns the supplied planned-exposure packet. Hash consistency was checked within that packet; original external source files and live release or activation were not inspected.
rule1Findings: The published solution and TII criterion expressly implement the cancellation-contradiction rule, including its precedence over follow-through. S0a7cb0eaaa and S5e21cdcbd5 retain all correct numerical answers but maintain contradictory assertions: each scores TII=0 and 9 overall, failing. S6896d9d441 additionally replaces both II individual values and scores 6. On the other side, commentless correct zero in Sd38c1bf8c1 and genuine express self-correction in S043ffa5a43 each retain 12. No additional explanatory task or hidden pass veto was applied.
rule2Findings: One substantive wrong cart value in S918a8cbb3a and Sab1a3f0a48, and one wrong mass in S4ee6c4447f, each costs 1.5 once: all score 10.5 and deliberately pass. Repeated wrong mass in S1a8be51d9d, copied wrong B value in S7f61869b97, repeated ignored sign in S0be0971aad, repeated magnitude rule in S221fc1e450 and mixed-cart inputs in S88d3cf99a1 each lose at least 3 and score 9, failing. Actual pair swaps in S22cb8cdfe3 and S6c3af64c9b lose both affected cart allocations and score 9. Valid totals retain follow-through throughout. Supported isolated arithmetic and sign slips in S21445d9bf5 and S4ca874545b instead lose 0.5 once at their source and score 11.5.
